article.story: SPARTANBURG, S.C. -- — Jordan Frison's 19 points helped Chattanooga defeat Wofford 76-67 on Wednesday. Frison added five assists for the Mocs (8-10, 2/3 Southern Conference). Tate Darner added 16 points while going 4 of 10 from the floor, including 3 for 5 from 3-point range, and 5 for 7 from the line and had six rebounds. Billy Smith had 13 points. Kahmare Holmes led the Terriers (11-7, 3-2) in scoring, finishing with 22 points, seven rebounds and two steals. Cayden Vasko added 15 points and six assists for Wofford. Nils Machowski also recorded 14 points and six rebounds. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
